title: U.S. Auctions 31.5 Million Acres of Pacific Ocean to Deep Sea Mining Company
summary: The first-ever lease sale took place over the objections of a federal judge. Wetstone U.S. Ventures paid $6 million to lease the seabed for mapping and preparation, not actual mining.
caption: A polymetallic nodule field on the abyssal plain off American Samoa, observed at a depth of 3.4 miles in August.

title: Senate Passes Major Permitting Bill to Speed Up Energy Projects
summary: The bill would overhaul federal environmental laws to make it easier to build everything from gas pipelines to wind farms. But it faces hurdles in the House.
caption: Power lines that carry electricity from Utah’s Intermountain Power Plant to Los Angeles run through Delta, Utah.

title: Quantum Computing Is Even Weirder Than You Think
summary: In a new study, Google researchers demonstrated a strange phenomenon called quantum contextuality, in which a quantum machine’s data can change as the context does.
caption: A quantum computer at Google’s Quantum A.I. Lab in Santa Barbara, Calif.
